title: Dodgers DON DRYSDALE SIGNED AUTO Salvino Figurine LTD ED w/COA 0049/2500
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Autographs-Original:Baseball-MLB:Other Autographed MLB Items
descriptionText:
This limited edition figurine is a must-have for any Dodgers fan. Signed by the legendary pitcher Don Drysdale, this collectible is a true gem. With a certificate of authenticity and a limited production run of only 2500, this figurine is a rare find for any collector.

Featuring Don Drysdale in his Dodgers uniform, this original MLB item is perfect for display in any sports memorabilia collection. Whether you're an avid collector or a casual fan, this autographed figurine is a great addition to your collection.
